messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for /api/v1/generate across us-west-2. Error rate 18% -> paging oncall. Paging Priya (oncall)
Priya (oncall): I’m on it. pulling up dashboards. seeing spike starting at ~1767890000, latency also up. Which stack is fronting this?
Alex M.: frontend LB (lb-prod-usw2) -> envoy gateway -> inference pool. I can see a sudden surge of 503/504 from the gateway.
Sasha (SRE): I’m seeing a pattern: the gateway envoy is returning 503s with upstream reset_reason=connect_failure. A couple of hosts in the inference pool are flapping.
Priya (oncall): Triage plan: 1) confirm whether this is routing/weighting issue on LB 2) check envoy retry/circuit-breaker config change history 3) Mitigate with traffic steering to healthy pool if possible.
Jamal (infra): Checking LB config. No infra deploys in last hour. But there was an automated rollout of route weights at 1767889800 (canary swap). Pulling audit logs.
deploy-bot: AUTO-DEPLOY: route-weight-swap completed by pipeline at 1767889800 (id: rw-swap-2026-03-15).
Tia (support): Customer impact: support queues show a dozen customers reporting timeout errors in the last 10 mins, top customers A and B. Marking P2 until mitigated.
Priya (oncall): Can someone tail envoy logs for a problematic gateway instance? I’ll collect a sample.
Alex M.: grabbing logs from envoy-gw-7. Relevant excerpts:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] envoy info: route: /api/v1/generate -> upstream cluster inference-pool (host ip=10.2.3.45) response_code=503 response_flags="UF,UR" reset_reason=connect_failure
[2026-03-15T10:12:35Z] envoy debug: retrying request, config retry_on="5xx,connect-failure", num_attempts=1
[2026-03-15T10:12:35Z] envoy info: connection close to upstream host 10.2.3.45:443: error ECONNRESET
```
Priya (oncall): Retry config looks suspicious; retries enabled on the gateway and again on the LB -> potential retry amplification.
Sasha (SRE): Also seeing circuit_breakers configured with max_connections: 1 for that cluster (inference-pool). That is dangerously low for this throughput and will cause connection churn and upstream overload.
Jamal (infra): Confirmed: cluster "inference-pool" has circuit_breakers: thresholds: priority: default: max_connections: 1. This matches the recent canary config change (rw-swap-2026-03-15) which included a narrower cb as an experimental safeguard.
Priya (oncall): That explains it: route weight swap pushed more traffic to this pool and cb max_connections=1 caused immediate head-of-line blocking and resets; with retries enabled on multiple layers we get retry storms and 5xx amplification.
Tia (support): Noted. Messaging customers A and B with outage acknowledgement.
Alex M.: Mitigation options: 1) revert the canary route-weight swap 2) bump circuit_breakers to sane defaults (max_connections: 100) 3) disable retries on gateway (retry_on none) to stop amplification.
Priya (oncall): Do we have the ability to revert the route-weight quickly? Jamal?
Jamal (infra): Yes. We can roll back the route-weight to previous values in the LB controlplane. Rolling back now to drain traffic away from inference-pool. Executing: `lbctl set-weights --service inference --weights previous`
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: route-weight-swap reversed by automation at 1767890300 (rw-swap-rollback).
Alex M.: Also applying stop-gap: patching envoy gateway config to disable retries and increase cb threshold. Patching via config override (hot-reload).
Priya (oncall): Commands being run: 
```
# increase cb
envoy-admin set-cluster-config inference-pool '{"circuit_breakers": {"thresholds": [{"max_connections": 100}]}}'
# disable retries on route
envoy-admin set-route-config route-id-42 '{"retry_policy": {"retry_on": "none"}}'
```
Sasha (SRE): Changes applied to gateway and cluster on 2 nodes at 1767890360, remainder rolling. Seeing immediate drop in connection resets and 5xx spike subsiding.
Priya (oncall): Metrics check: error rate down from 18% -> 2% over last 2 minutes, p99 latency reduced. Continuing to monitor.
Tia (support): Sent update to affected customers: "We routed around an unhealthy host pool and disabled gateway retries to stop amplification. Services should be recovering; please reach out if issues persist."
Alex M.: Post-mortem notes to capture: - root cause: canary route weight increase routed significant traffic to pool with experimental cb max_connections=1 - contributing: retries configured at multiple layers causing amplification - impact: elevated 5xx and timeouts for customers A/B - immediate fix: rollback route weights + bump cb + disable retries - followups: revert experimental cb config from canary until tested, add automated check for cb thresholds vs expected throughput, enforce single-retry policy at gateway only.
Priya (oncall): Oncall handoff: I’ll stay until full recovery. Paging SRE rotation for long-term follow-up. Sasha, Jamal, please file the infra RFC to remove aggressive cb defaults and add guardrails.
Sasha (SRE): Will open RFC-1234 and include a reconciliation job to validate cb values vs capacity.
Jamal (infra): I’ll add a canary gating check to the route-weight pipeline so cb thresholds are validated before traffic shift.
Priya (oncall): Closing paging: issue mitigated at 1767890423. Will update the incident tracker with timeline and customer impact.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem and action items.
